# Media Puppies

> Performance marketing agency in Noida, Delhi NCR, India. We run Meta and
> Google ads, SEO and AI automation for businesses where one customer is
> worth real money, and we report in cost per customer rather than
> impressions. Founded 2018. Month to month, no lock-in. We audit an
> account before quoting, and we say no when paid media is not the right
> spend yet.

Updated 14 October 2026. 153 articles, 26 free calculators, 39 service and
market pages.

## How we charge

A flat monthly retainer, month to month, no lock-in. Never a percentage of
ad spend, because that pays an agency more for spending more of your money
and makes "reduce this budget" an expensive sentence to say. We quote after
a free audit of the live account rather than before, because the honest
number depends on what the account actually needs. Our floor is roughly
₹50,000 a month in ad spend — below that an account cannot gather enough
conversions to optimise against, and we say so rather than take the fee.

## Free calculators

Twenty-six browser-only tools. Nothing is sent to a server; the arithmetic
runs in the page and nothing typed into them is stored or transmitted.

https://mediapuppies.com/tools/ — including break-even ROAS, blended ROAS
and MER, CAC payback, customer lifetime value, contribution margin, lead
funnel, Meta learning phase, ad frequency, budget pacing, PPC forecast,
A/B test sample size and significance, GST on ad spend, marketplace payout,
COD versus prepaid, creative volume, churn and retention, agency versus
in-house cost, influencer rate, UTM builder and SERP snippet preview.
